'''Gunther O. Hofmann''' (born 22 May 1957 in [[Landshut]], [[Bavaria]]) is a German [[surgeon]], [[biophysics|biophysicist]], and professor.

==Early life and education==
Gunther O. Hofmann was born in 1957 in [[Landshut]], [[Bavaria]].

Hofmann attended medical school and earned a [[Staatsexamen]] and a [[Doctor of Philosophy#Germany|doctorate]] (Dr. med.) from [[LMU Munich]]. Thereafter, he moved to the [[Technical University of Munich]], where he graduated in 1984 with a Dr. rer. nat. (''Doctor rerum naturalium'') in physics.

==Career==
In 1987, Hofmann commenced work as a research fellow at the [[LMU Klinikum]] until he started his [[Habilitation]] in 1992. During his habilitation, Hofmann did research at the [[Massachusetts General Hospital]] in [[Boston]], [[Massachusetts]], and started to work at [[LMU Klinikum]] (hospital of [[LMU Munich]]) in the same year.

In 1995, he moved to the ''Berufsgenossenschaftliche Unfallklinik'' (BG Trauma Hospital) [[Murnau am Staffelsee|Murnau]].

Since 2004, Hofmann has been the medical director of [[Berufsgenossenschaftliche Kliniken Bergmannstrost Halle|Berufsgenossenschaftliche Kliniken Bergmannstrost]] [[Halle, Saxony-Anhalt]] and Director of Hospital for Trauma, Hand, and Reconstructive Surgery at the [[University of Jena|Friedrich Schiller University]] of [[Jena]], [[Thuringia]].

===Research interests===
His major research fields are Development of implants for [[osteosynthesis]] and [[joint replacement]], [[bone grafting|bone and joint grafting]], [[biomaterials]], [[biomechanics]], [[computer-assisted surgery]], infections of bones
* Example (2010): Development of a [[prosthetic]] hand with microsensors<ref>[http://www.innovations-report.de/html/berichte/energie_elektrotechnik/prosthesis_information_fingertips_159385.html prosthetic hand with microsensors] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120320065853/http://www.innovations-report.de/html/berichte/energie_elektrotechnik/prosthesis_information_fingertips_159385.html |date=2012-03-20 }} 15.04.2011</ref>

* 2006 ''Knochen- und Gelenktransplantation'' (Bone and joint transplantation)<ref>[https://www.reference-global.com/doi/abs/10.1515/9783110200195.236 Bone and joint transplantation]{{dead link|date=October 2017 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} 16.04.2011</ref> in: ''Transplantationsmedizin.
